}

for _,cp in ipairs({1.5,2,3})do for _,ignore_direct_crits in ipairs({0,20,50,100})do

 assert(math.abs(dam-(100+100*(cp-1)*(1-ignore_direct_crits/100)))<1e-9)
end end
